title: Consumer route and peer coverage maturity refresh
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Distinguish FreeCAD's selectable DXF importer backends and their documented entity scopes
Separate explicit faceted geometry projection from ACIS/ASM carrier and B-rep semantics
Reconcile LibreDWG headline revision coverage with per-class maturity and test coverage
Refine the composed Linux/Windows consumer matrix without increasing per-slice validation

sources.observation: The page describes a bundled C++ importer and optional legacy Python importer, both for R12+ DXF, with different listed entity subsets. It states ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read. DWG conversion is a converter-to-DXF-to-importer chain, so the backend and converter are part of the qualification identity.

The discussion distinguishes explicit DXF entities from ACIS blobs and corroborates that FreeCAD cannot currently interpret the blobs as geometry. This is not normative format evidence or a local reproduction.

The manual partitions class coverage into unstable/undertested, unhandled, halfway, and lacking sample test coverage. It names BODY, MESH, and other families without test coverage, and lists ACDSRECORD/ACDSSCHEMA as unhandled. Broad coverage claims therefore cannot substitute for exact per-family/corpus evidence.

A release-history entry says AcDsPrototype_1b support was incomplete and describes brute-force extraction of some modern SAB blobs. Used only as a historical risk signal, not a claim about every current build.

OGR projects explicit faces and polyface meshes to polygonal/polyhedral geometries, but tessellates or simplifies other CAD features and inlines INSERTs by default. Its separate AC1027+ 3D-extensible path exposes raw ASM bytes plus a 12-value transform; it does not reconstruct OGR solids and skips those entities by default.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Added a route-aware FreeCAD platform matrix, separated explicit facet projection from modeler-carrier and B-rep claims, and required peer evidence to be pinned by class, version, corpus, and operation. This is a one-time composed-gate refinement only.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the already-listed local-ready PAR-138 SectionViewStyle occurrence work; do not wait for FreeCAD, GDAL, LibreDWG, or any external route.

method.limitations: FreeCAD, LibreDWG, and GDAL documentation is mutable and describes project-specific behavior. No runtime interoperability was performed. The research refines evidence admission and does not promote format, carrier, shape-semantic, or native-consumer support.

validation.planEdit: Added source-backed route distinctions, per-family peer maturity rules, explicit-facet versus modeler gates, and a bounded Linux/Windows acceptance manifest.
